source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of AC through an inductor (PDF 94-96).

blocks.text: Inductor (jise coil ya choke bhi kehte hain) do siron wala hissa hai jis ki self-inductance zyada aur resistance na-qabil-e-zikr hai; current guzarne par yeh tawanai magnetic field mein jama karta hai. Yeh current ke achanak ubhar (surges ya spikes) ko tawanai waqti taur par jama kar ke aur circuit mein wapas de kar dheema karta hai.

blocks.alt: Teen qatarein. Resistor: AC source aur resistor R ka circuit; V (sabz) aur I (surkh) ke graphs saath uthte girte; phasors V aur I aik simt mein; R = V/I. Inductor: source aur coil L; current ka graph voltage se chauthai chakkar peeche; phasor I, V se 90 darje peeche; XL = wL = 2 pi f L. Capacitor: source aur capacitor C; current ka graph chauthai chakkar aage; phasor I, V se 90 darje aage; XC = 1/wC = 1/(2 pi f C).
blocks.caption: Resistor, inductor aur capacitor se AC (Figs 17.6 se 17.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Resistor V aur I ko hum-qadam rakhta hai. Inductor current ki tabdeeli ki mukhalfat karta, is liye current chauthai chakkar peeche reh jata; capacitor ka voltage barhne se pehle current use charge karta hai, is liye current chauthai chakkar aage chalta hai.

blocks.text: Farz karein inductor L frequency f ke AC source se jura hai (Fig 17.7 a) aur current I = Io sin(wt) (17.13) hai. Badalta current coil mein L dI/dt miqdar ki ulti emf (back emf) banata hai, aur lagaya voltage is ke barabar hona chahiye: V = L (d/dt)(Io sin(wt)) = L Io w cos(wt) (17.14). Vo = w L Io ke saath V = Vo cos(wt) = Vo sin(wt + pi/2) (17.15). Yun inductor par voltage current se 90 darje (pi/2 rad) aage hai; yani inductor mein current voltage se 90 darje peeche hai (Figs 17.7 b aur c).

blocks.title: Inductive reactance
blocks.text: Inductor ki mukhalfat us ki inductive reactance hai, XL = Vrms / Irms (17.16). Kyunke Vrms = 0.707 Vo, Irms = 0.707 Io aur Vo = w L Io, XL = w L = 2 pi f L (17.17). Is ki ikai ohm hai.

XL frequency aur inductance dono ke barah-e-raast mutanasib hai. DC ke liye f = 0, is liye XL = 0; zyada frequency par XL bara hai. Is liye inductor DC guzarta lekin zyada frequency ke AC ki mukhalfat (rokta) karta hai.

Khalis inductor mein aust zaya taqat sifar hai. Inductor taqat kharch nahi karta: yeh har chakkar ke kuch hisse mein tawanai magnetic field mein jama karta aur field khatam hone par source ko wapas deta hai. Kyunke V aur I mein 90 darje ka phase farq hai, fi chakkar aust taqat sifar hai. Is liye inductor tawanai kharch kiye baghair AC qaboo kar sakta hai.

blocks.title: Taqat ka phase
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke inductive circuit mein lamhati taqat sifar hai. Asal mein lamhati taqat VI musbat aur manfi hoti rehti hai (tawanai magnetic field mein aati jati hai); chakkar ka aust sifar hai.

Na-qabil-e-zikr resistance wali 400 mH coil mein 1 kHz par 6 mA rms current hai. Is par rms voltage maloom karein. Hal: XL = 2 pi f L = 2 x 3.14 x 1000 Hz x 0.400 H = 2512 ohm, is liye Vrms = Irms XL = (6 x 10^-3 A)(2512 ohm) = 15 V.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: dI/dt waqt ke saath current ki tabdeeli ki sharah, yani I-t graph ki dhalwan hai. Chokes ki kai qismein hain: filter chokes, high-frequency chokes, radio-frequency chokes aur AC qaboo karne wale chokes (kitab mein tasaveer).

blocks.prompt: Frequency dugni karne par inductor ki reactance ka kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh dugni ho jati hai, kyunke XL = 2 pi f L, f ke mutanasib hai.

items: Inductor: V, I se 90 darje aage (I peeche).
XL = wL = 2 pi f L: DC ke liye sifar, zyada f par bara.
